SOCIAL STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Vegetation in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Vegetation in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Vegetation in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation in Africa.
   D. Treat Vegetation in Africa as rumours only.

2. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   B. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   D. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Replace the compass rose

4. Which statement about Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe.
   C. Say Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe as rumours only.

5. Which statement about Diversity and interpersonal skills is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Diversity and interpersonal skills as rumours only.
   B. Say Diversity and interpersonal skills never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Diversity and interpersonal skills.
   D. Explain Diversity and interpersonal skills with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Self- Improvement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Improvement.
   B. Treat Self- Improvement as rumours only.
   C. Say Self- Improvement never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Self- Improvement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

8. Which statement about Scientific Theory about Human Origin is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Scientific Theory about Human Origin never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Scientific Theory about Human Origin as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Scientific Theory about Human Origin.
   D. Explain Scientific Theory about Human Origin with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Trans Saharan Slave Trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Trans Saharan Slave Trade never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Trans Saharan Slave Trade as rumours only.
   C. Explain Trans Saharan Slave Trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Trans Saharan Slave Trade.

10. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

11. Which statement about Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration.

12. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Nakuru
   C. Nairobi
   D. Kisumu

13. Which statement about Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain.
   C. Treat Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain as rumours only.
   D. Say Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain never happens in Kenya.

14. Which statement about Population Growth in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Population Growth in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Population Growth in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Population Growth in Africa as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Population Growth in Africa.

15. Which statement about Self- Esteem Assessment is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Self- Esteem Assessment with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Self- Esteem Assessment as rumours only.
   C. Say Self- Esteem Assessment never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Esteem Assessment.

16. Which statement about Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ●.
   C. Explain Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Trans Saharan Slave Trade and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Population Growth in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Diversity and interpersonal skills and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Map Reading and Interpretation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
